title: Lock follow-ups: a dead or reused pid's landing ticket never blocks, an interrupted land or claim leaves nothing behind, and a first pass with nothing to wait for ends cleanly
goal: a landing does not wait for a ticket asked before its process started or older than the lock's wait bound, so a ticket left by a killed landing whose pid was reused holds nobody up; landing_lock removes a ticket it created on any interrupt and restores the SIGTERM handler it replaced; claim puts the coord run state back to released on any failure after it took the state; land moves the run state of a first pass that ended not done yet with no pending merge request to refused naming the step merge request
